title: AI Book Translator input
description: Upload one permitted EPUB, TXT, Markdown or HTML book, choose a target language, and download an independently AI-reviewed translation. Very long chapters may be rejected; PDF and DOCX are not supported.

bookFiles.title: Book file
bookFiles.description: Upload one EPUB, TXT, HTML/XHTML or Markdown file. Content is processed by Apify and the operator's LLM provider. Do not upload files you are not authorized to translate.

targetLanguage.title: Target language
targetLanguage.description: Language to translate into (e.g. Russian, German, English).

sourceLanguage.title: Source language
sourceLanguage.description: Optional. Provide the source language or leave blank when unknown.

title.title: Book title
title.description: Optional title for the assembled output.

author.title: Author
author.description: Optional author metadata for the assembled output.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: The Actor produces only fully reviewed books. Select EPUB, Markdown, or both.
